# Local player dependencies

hls.js 1.7.4: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js
JASSUB 2.5.35: https://github.com/ThaUnknown/jassub (including libass and its font/rendering dependencies).

Keep the accompanying license notices. Source and build instructions are available in the linked upstream repositories. Rebuild these separate, replaceable assets with npm run build:vendor.
